# basis: two-number. OVERHEAD = empty Icon program per engine (wall/cpu ms): iconx 0/0 jcont 90/140 m3 0/0 m4 0/0. WORK = median - OVERHEAD.
# multiple = rival WORK / SCRIP m4 WORK on the SAME instrument (FASTER axis, >1 = SCRIP ahead). CEO-173: OVERHEAD >= 50% of an arm => basis=TOTAL.
